subject: mathematics
content: If the equation of the plane passing through the point $$(1,1,2)$$ and perpendicular to the line $$x-3 y+ 2 z-1=0=4 x-y+z$$ is $$\mathrm{A} x+\mathrm{B} y+\mathrm{C} z=1$$, then $$140(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{A})$$ is equal to ___________.
